Scoring values and tiebreak

The harder the challenge, the more it is worth. Every challenge starts at a value set by its difficulty and can never fall below a floor:

Difficulty  | Starts at  | Floor
--- | --- | ---
Informational  | 50  | 50
Easy  | 200  | 120
Medium  | 450  | 270
Hard  | 900  | 540
Insane  | 1800  | 1080

The more teams solve a challenge, the less it is worth, down to that floor. This applies to everyone equally, including whoever solved it first, so your score can move while you are asleep.

If two teams finish on the same score, the one that got there earlier ranks higher.

Writeup submission

Send your writeup to csctf@chronos-security.ro with the subject `WRITEUP - <division> - <team name>`. One mail per team, in any format: a PDF, a markdown file, or a link to your own repo or blog. The deadline is 9 November 15:00 EET and the mail timestamp is what counts.

### Final details before the event

Platform details will be confirmed closer to the event and announced on Discord. The scoring values, format, brackets, and writeup requirement above are set.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

比赛形式

本次挑战赛为”0人工”全智能化挖洞挑战，分为线上初赛和现场决赛；参赛团队可自主开发或任意组合市面上的大模型，构建自己的”agentic AI”，使用”agentic AI”在OpenHarmony真实系统环境进行漏洞挖掘挑战。

初赛、决赛的0day漏洞均需通过OpenHarmony安全漏洞奖励计划（https://bugbounty.openharmony.cn/）进行提交，漏洞的判定结果由奖励计划评审组决定。对应有效的0day漏洞奖金由OpenHarmony安全漏洞奖励计划提供。

线上初赛

Image

  * 参赛团队需要在规定时间内且”0人工”干预的情况下，使用团队的”agentic AI”按要求在比赛环境挖掘OpenHarmony Nday漏洞获得积分。

  * Nday漏洞为真实在OpenHarmony Release版本发现并已修复的漏洞。

  * 晋级名额暂定15支。

  * 线上初赛限定每队人数不超过4人。

  * 线上初赛冠军战队可直接获得第十一届XCTF国际网络攻防联赛总决赛入场券。

初赛积分&晋级规则

采用动态分值每个有效发现满分10分，根据完成度获得对应积分；

| | | | | — | — | — | | 文件路径+漏洞触发代码行（精确到代码行标记） | 漏洞引入Commit Hash | 漏洞类型CWE类型 | | 5 | 4 | 1 |

为确保解题过程提交漏洞位置准确，请确保漏洞挖掘环境为社区原始发布且未带入任何版本发布后修复的PR补丁，以免出现漏洞触发行号偏移。

初赛赛程2/3（大致2-3周）：晋级积分排名前10名（或总参赛队伍前10%）且积分中需包含不少于5个得分≥9分Nday漏洞。

初赛赛程后1/3（大致1周）排位冲刺：抢先达到50分的前5名（或未晋级参赛队伍前5%）队伍晋级。

防爆破：参赛过程中禁止采用爆破猜想的方式，采用爆破猜想的参赛团队将被冻结当日提交资格，冻结次数达三次将取消参赛资格。

https://repo.huaweicloud.com/openharmony/os/6.0-Release/code-v6.0-Release.tar.gz

RK3568标准系统解决方案（二进制）ROM包

https://repo.huaweicloud.com/openharmony/os/6.0-Release/dayu200_standard_arm32_rom.tar.gz

RK3568标准系统解决方案（二进制）XTS包

https://repo.huaweicloud.com/openharmony/os/6.0-Release/dayu200_standard_arm32_xts.tar.gz

关于比赛测试环境部署说明

  1. 需满足可运行OpenHarmony v6.0 Release及最新Release版本的环境。

  2. 参赛团队可根据自身环境条件选择使用开发板或虚拟模拟器。

  3. 开发板使用建议：润和DAYU200 RK3568。

比赛平台及Agent交互接口说明见比赛平台《第二届OpenHarmony CTF智能漏洞挖掘赛平台使用说明》文档及交互Skills附件。

0day漏洞附加分

附加分：初赛期间挖出0day漏洞，通过0day漏洞提交入口，在限定的审核工单数量限制内，提交0day漏洞报告，或者针对模块漏洞被评估为Flag错误的误报进行申诉为0day漏洞，如获得审核通过，可获得额外0day漏洞积分，记入初赛总分排名：

| | | | | | — | — | — | — | | 严重 | 高危 | 中危 | 低危 | | N*100 | N*60 | N*30 | N*10 |

* N为对应数量。

0day漏洞提交

1、初赛通过有效0day漏洞获得附加分需满足Nday漏洞得分200分，否则得分不计入0day漏洞附加分；

2、有效0day漏洞提交范围需与初赛Nday漏洞赛题代码仓范围一致且满足《OpenHarmony安全漏洞奖励计划》规则要求；

3、有效0day漏洞的判定以《OpenHarmony安全漏洞奖励计划》反馈为准；

4、提交0day漏洞时在标题加上〖OpenHarmony CTF+队名〗标签以便识别并优先进行处理。

* 注：如在比赛过程中按照0day漏洞提交但被审核为未在预期数据集中的Nday漏洞或无效漏洞，将不获得积分。

CSCTF 2026

# Rules

The rules that keep the board fair and available to everyone.

Taking part

## Teams and Divisions

  * CSCTF 2026 runs from 6 November, 15:00 EET to 8 November, 15:00 EET.
  * New-account registration closes at kickoff. Existing accounts can create or join a squad during the competition.
  * A squad has one to five people; a solo squad is valid. One account and one squad per person.
  * Choose Juniors (under 18), Seniors (18 and over), or Fighters (open). Junior podium eligibility may be checked after the event.

Community and support

## Respect the People Playing

  * Keep community spaces SFW and respectful. No harassment, hate speech, NSFW content, doxxing, impersonation or unsolicited OSINT against real people.
  * Keep discussion relevant to CSCTF and cybersecurity. Use the general channel for casual chat; do not spam, post unsolicited promotion or share Discord invites without staff approval. Use a clear, non-offensive nickname.
  * Do not share leaked credentials, internal documents, classified material or live malware outside official CTF challenge files. Do not use it.

Staff may temporarily restrict a squad while investigating, remove affected solves or points, or disqualify a squad. Repeated or deliberate abuse is grounds for disqualification. Appeals must be sent by ticket or to contact@chronos-security.ro with subject Appeal within 24 hours of the decision. The decision after review is final.

Scoring

## How Points Work

  * Challenge values fall as more squads solve them, never below their difficulty floor.
  * The first three global solves receive 8%, 5% and 2% of the challenge's starting value. Informational warm-ups have no first-blood bonus.
  * If teams tie, the team that reached the score first ranks higher.

Close and writeups

## Confirming the Podium

  * At 8 November, 15:00 EET, scoring closes. Challenges remain available afterward for learning and writeups, but later solves do not change the result.
  * Top-three teams in every division submit one team writeup covering every credited challenge by 9 November, 11:00 EET.
  * Send one PDF, Markdown file, repository or blog link to csctf@chronos-security.ro, subject WRITEUP - division - team name.
  * Any team may submit a writeup for Best Technical Writeup or Best AI-Assisted Methodology.
  * A podium place is provisional until its writeup passes review. If it does not arrive, the place passes down.

Prize delivery

## Getting Awards to Winners

  * Prize packages cover verified squad members recorded at scoring close, up to five. Provider prizes may have their own eligibility terms.
  * Physical prizes are subject to provider delivery coverage, applicable export or sanctions controls, local customs rules and the recipient's address.
  * If a provider cannot lawfully or practically ship to a selected recipient, the team may nominate another verified member in a serviceable location. If that is not possible, we may offer a reasonable non-cash alternative where one is available. Cash substitution and delivery to third parties are not available.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CSCTF 2026

# FAQ

The questions we are asked most. If yours is not here, ask in Discord.

The Basics

## When, How Long, How Much

  * 6 to 8 November 2026. Doors open 15:00 EET on the 6th and it runs 48 hours straight.
  * Entry is free. There is nothing to pay at any point.
  * Teams of 1–5. One person is a valid team and is not excluded from any prize.
  * Fully online. Play from anywhere.

Divisions

## Who You Compete Against

  * Juniors — under 18.
  * Seniors — 18 and over.
  * Fighters — the open bracket, where the largest prizes are.

Each division has its own scoreboard and its own podium. A sixteen year old is never scored against a working pentester.

The Theme

## Do I Need a Defence or Energy Background?

No. Total Warfare describes the scenario a challenge is set in, not the knowledge needed to solve it. Every challenge is solved with ordinary security skills. The setting is a substation, a hospital network or a rail signalling system rather than an abstract puzzle, and the challenge hands you everything you need to work on it.

Challenges

## What You Will Be Solving

  * Web, pwn, reverse engineering, crypto, forensics, OSINT, OT and SCADA, hardware.
  * Difficulty runs from approachable to genuinely hard, so there is a way in at every level.
  * Dynamic scoring: a challenge is worth less as more teams solve it.
